name: es20-textures-2d
title: 2D textures: filtering, wrapping, formats, units
summary: Texture objects/units, NEAREST/LINEAR, three wrap modes, sub-image, unpack alignment, legacy unsized + packed formats, incomplete textures; checked against a CPU sampler (NEAREST exactly, LINEAR within the min/max of its texels).
spec: ES 3.0 §3.8.1 Texture Objects, §3.8.3 Texture Image Specification (Table 3.3 unsized formats)
ES 3.0 §3.8.10 Texture Minification (Table 3.22 wrap, bilinear eq.), §3.8.11 Magnification

api.glGenTextures: 12 texture objects; a generated-but-unbound name is not yet a texture
api.glBindTexture: per-unit binding (TEXTURE_BINDING_2D on unit 3); 2D texture on CUBE_MAP target -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glActiveTexture: unit 3 sampled in cell 14; ACTIVE_TEXTURE = GL_TEXTURE3
api.glTexImage2D: RGBA/RGB/LUMINANCE/LUMINANCE_ALPHA/ALPHA and 565/4444/5551 uploads pixel-verified; border=1 and width=-1 -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glTexSubImage2D: 2x2 patch replaces exactly those texels; out-of-range -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glIsTexture: FALSE before first bind, TRUE after, FALSE after delete
api.glPixelStorei: UNPACK_ALIGNMENT 4 (padded rows) vs 1 (tight) give identical texels; value 3 -> INVALID_VALUE

visual_review.notes: radeonsi: NEAREST/LINEAR/REPEAT(3x3)/MIRRORED rows correct; clamp stretches edges; white sub-image patch; align4==align1; legacy formats; unit-3 magenta half; incomplete cell black.
